status: partial; experimental router is opt-in; default terrain unchanged
method: Fresh generated native chunks; unchanged A3/A5 plans and tolerances. Official manifests checked against cached A3 statistics. Biome/depth statistics, no equal-coordinate height comparison.
full_census: Not run: GitHub workflow builds a committed revision; this work is uncommitted.
candidate_switch: MCSA_A6_DENSITY=1; absent or zero keeps the original generator

generated_support_control_fixture.method: Matched-biome regression: generated jagged_peaks Y144. Reference is the measured official A5 peak window, 7 air cells / 8999 eligible cells, plus the unchanged two percentage point tolerance. A nonempty denominator and unchanged surface biome selection are required.

before.definition: Surface biome of highest natural block; solid excludes air/water/lava. Raw gap proxy: any air above sea at least six below top, including enclosed caves. Sky-connected overhangs additionally require a six-neighbour air path to Y319 inside the chunk; paths crossing chunk faces are not followed, so frequency is a lower bound. Profiles aggregate per biome, never require matching positions. Bands match unchanged census. Upper-run thickness is truncated at Y63.
